featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

today.rule:
⚙️ Konvoy Kuralları (Rules):

Bu konvoyda tüm TruckersMP kuralları geçerlidir. 🧭
Lütfen güvenli ve keyifli bir sürüş için aşağıdaki ek kurallara da dikkat ediniz:

🚫 Sollama Yasaktır.
🚫 Cars (Arabalar) Kullanmak Yasaktır.
🚫 Scout Araçları yalnızca etkinlik yönetim ekibine aittir.
🚫 Troll, spam, ani durma veya kural ihlali yapanlar konvoydan uzaklaştırılır.
🚫 Aşırı hız yapmayın, grubun temposuna uyun.
🚫 Far ve korna spamlama yasaktır.
🚫 CB Radyo’yu gereksiz konuşmalar için kullanmayın.
✅ Takip mesafesini koruyun ve öndeki tıra dikkat edin.
✅ Etkinlik yöneticilerinin ve CC (Convoy Control) ekibinin talimatlarına uyun.

Kurallara uymayan sürücüler, etkinlikten çıkarılabilir.
Hedefimiz güvenli, düzenli ve eğlenceli bir sürüş! 🚛💨

⚙️ Convoy Rules (EN):

All TruckersMP rules apply during this event. 🧭
Please follow the additional rules below to ensure a safe and enjoyable convoy:

🚫 Overtaking is strictly forbidden.
🚫 Cars (Scout vehicles) are not allowed.
🚫 Scout vehicles are reserved only for Event Staff.
🚫 Trolling, spamming, sudden braking, or rule violations will result in removal.
🚫 Do not overspeed, follow the convoy leader’s pace.
🚫 No horn or high beam spam.
🚫 Keep CB Radio clear and avoid unnecessary chatter.
✅ Maintain safe distance from the truck ahead.
✅ Always follow Event Staff and CC (Convoy Control) instructions.

Drivers who fail to comply with these rules may be removed from the event.
Let’s enjoy a safe, respectful, and fun convoy! 🚛💨

upcoming.rule:
1. 🔒 This is a public car-only convoy. Only passenger cars are allowed to participate; all trucks, trailers, freight vehicles and special vehicles are strictly prohibited from joining the convoy.
2. 📄 All participants must strictly abide by the official TruckersMP User Agreement, server code of conduct and online game rules.
3. 🚗 Maintain a constant slow speed and safe distance at all times. Speeding, ramming, drifting, reckless lane changes and forced overtaking are strictly forbidden.
4. 🎖️ Obey all arrangements and instructions from event organizers, convoy leaders and traffic marshals. Do not leave the team, take the lead or change lanes without permission.
5. ⚠️ Malicious road blocking, position hogging, cutting off other vehicles, colliding with teammates and other behaviors that disrupt the overall convoy order are strictly prohibited.
6. 🛑 Do not stop randomly or cut in line after disconnection during the drive. If temporary parking is needed, please signal in advance and stay away from the main convoy route.
7. 🤝 Respect every participant, drive politely and communicate friendly. Quarrels, spamming and malicious teasing that damage the event atmosphere are not allowed.
8. 🚫 Organizers reserve the right to remove players who violate event and server rules from the convoy immediately. Severe violations will be recorded and reported to TruckersMP officials for review and punishment.
9. ✅ All participants are requested to check game mods, game files and network status in advance to ensure smooth participation in this public convoy event.

Veranstaltungsregeln für Teilnehmer

Die Teilnehmer müssen den Anweisungen des Veranstaltungspersonals Folge leisten.

Die Teilnehmer sollten auf ihren zugewiesenen Parkplätzen parken das keine Kollisionsverhütung anbietet.

Die Teilnehmer dürfen den Startpunkt erst verlassen, wenn sie dazu aufgefordert werden, und zwar geordnet (einer nach dem anderen).

Die Teilnehmer müssen während des Konvois einen Anhänger ziehen.

Konfigurationen für Schwerlasttransporte sind nicht zulässig.

Event Rules for Participants


* The Event Staff are recognized as; “Elite | Staff" or similar.

* Free roaming on the server is prohibited

* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.

* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Cars and Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.

* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)

* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.

* Advertising on the server is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Overtaking on the server is prohibited.

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.

* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.

* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.

All other TruckersMP rules apply.

⭐ **Event Rules for Event Staff**


*Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.

*Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.

*Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.

*Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff

All other TruckersMP rules apply.
